name: Smoke (Sniper)
notes: Smoke rules p. 190; adding smoke to light smoke makes it heavy. Half the Sniper cost. Max 3 Strikes per player per turn (air cover, bluffs and minefields don't count). Low Visibility +1; a spotter with LOS both turns -2. Up to 5 pre-designated hexes per mapsheet, written before deployment: firing at one auto-hits. BV 160.
